ui.Знание закрепляется, когда к нему возвра: Knowledge sticks when you return to it. For every module you've finished, a second quiz is waiting here — with brand-new questions. The best time to visit is a day or two after the module: it's spaced repetition that turns understanding into long-term memory.

ui.Обратите внимание: при порядке 1 текст б: Notice: at order 1 the text quickly slides into nonsense ("the cat slept on the rain"); at order 2 the phrases hold together better — but the model mostly just repeats the corpus word for word. It has nowhere else to get context from.
ui.Веса и смещение — «характер» нейрона (то: Weights and bias — the neuron's "personality" (the part that training adjusts):
ui.Решение: остаюсь дома ({X}% за то, чтобы: Decision: staying home ({X}% in favor of staying)
ui.Попробуйте сделать вес дождя положительн: Try making the rain weight positive — you'll get a rain-loving neuron. Same mechanism, different weights — different "behavior." Training a network is finding weights just like these, only billions of them at once.
ui.Шарик — текущие веса, кривая — ошибка се: The ball is the current weights; the curve is the network's error at those weights. Try all three regimes: a small rate (~0.05) — the ball creeps into the nearest dip, even if it isn't the deepest one; a medium rate (~0.3) — quick and to the point; a large one (>1.2) — the ball leaps across valleys and can't settle down.
ui.Нажмите на любое слово — увидите его бли: Click any word to see its nearest neighbors in "meaning space."
ui.Ближайшие к <strong>«{W}»</strong>: {LIS: Nearest to "{W}": {LIST}. The number is the distance: the smaller it is, the closer the meaning.
ui.Серая стрелка — вектор «{M} → {F}». Пере: The gray arrow is the vector "{M} → {F}". Carry that same vector over to "{K}" (the orange one) — and you land exactly on "{Q}". Relationships of meaning have become directions in space — and you can do arithmetic with them.
ui.«Она» почти всё внимание отдаёт «рыбе» —: "It" gives almost all of its attention to "fish" — the fish was the spoiled one. Now click the button and watch what happens to that very same word "it".
ui.Одно слово поменялось в конце — и «она»: One word changed at the end — and "it" switched its attention to "cat": the cat was the full one. The model works out a word's meaning from the whole context, not just from its neighbors.

ui.Столько вам понадобится, чтобы прочитать: That's how long you'd need to read the pretraining corpus of a large language model: on the order of 15 trillion tokens — roughly {N} million books.

ui.Нажмите «Сначала», поменяйте температуру: Click "From the top", change the temperature — and the phrase will come out differently. This is exactly why a neural network answers the same question a little differently every time.
ui.Вероятности следующего слова (softmax от: Next-word probabilities (softmax over the logits at T = {T}):
ui.Поставьте T = 0.1 и нажимайте рулетку —: Set T = 0.1 and keep spinning — the top option will come up almost every time, and the phrase becomes predictable. Set T = 2 — the odds even out, and the cat starts bursting into song on the chandelier. "Take the most likely" is greedy decoding: boring, but reproducible.

ChatGPT's and Claude's "memory" of you works exactly the same way: the service keeps notes on the side and quietly inserts them at the start of every new chat.

ui.Всё, о чём вы читали, — сейчас произойдё: Everything you've been reading about is about to happen right before your eyes, without a single server: here in this page you'll assemble a network, generate data, train it with gradient descent, and make it recognize digits you draw yourself.
ui.Вход — картинка 8×8 пикселей, то есть 64: The input is an 8×8-pixel image — that is, 64 brightness numbers. Then comes a hidden layer (you choose its size), and the output is 10 neurons, one per digit. The more hidden neurons, the more "features" the network can learn — and the more parameters it has.
ui.Для сравнения: у сети, с которой вы сейч: For scale: the network you're chatting with has not hundreds of parameters but on the order of a trillion — yet the principle is exactly the same.
ui.В файл курса вшита тысяча с лишним насто: Sewn into this course file are over a thousand real handwritten digits — written by actual people for a classic handwriting-recognition dataset. This is the very kind of data the first serious neural networks learned from. Load them — and later compare the accuracy with the font-based version.
ui.Нейросети нужны примеры с правильными от: A neural network needs examples with the right answers attached. The page will now "write out" digits in hundreds of different styles — different fonts, tilted and shifted (that's called augmentation) — and shrink each one down to 8×8 pixels. The result is a small training dataset.
ui.{A} пойдут на обучение, {B} отложим для: {A} will go into training; {B} we'll set aside for an honest test (the network won't see them during training). Here are 60 at random — this is exactly how the network "sees" the digits:
ui.Заметно, насколько почерк разнообразнее: See how much more varied handwriting is than fonts? The network will have to work for it.
ui.Сейчас начнётся настоящий градиентный сп: Real gradient descent is about to happen: the network will look at every example, get it wrong, work out how much each weight is to blame, and nudge all {N} parameters a tiny bit. And so on for 30 epochs — 30 passes over all the examples.
ui.Во что превратились веса {H} скрытых ней: What the weights of the {H} hidden neurons have become (each square is one neuron's 64 weights: orange — "I want to see ink here", blue — "this should stay empty"):
ui.Сравнение источников: печатные шрифты —: Comparing the sources: printed fonts — {F}%, handwritten — {H}%. Real people's handwriting is more varied, so it's usually harder on the network — but a network trained on it will read your scrawl better in the next step.
ui.До обучения сеть угадывала бы ~10% (науг: Before training, the network would have guessed ~10% (pure chance). Every point above that is the work of the gradient descent you just watched.
ui.Слабовато. Попробуйте другую скорость об: A bit weak. Try a different learning rate or more hidden neurons — and train again.
ui.Эксперименты, которые стоит поставить: о: Experiments worth running: train with "tortoise" — the error curve will inch down at a crawl; with "way too wild" — it will bounce all over; go back to step 1 and set 2 neurons — the network will hit a ceiling, it simply won't have enough "memory" for 10 digits. And above all: train on both data sources from step 2 — and compare.
ui.Шаг 4. Испытайте её: Step 4. Put it to the test
ui.Нарисуйте цифру покрупнее, в центре поля: Draw a digit — nice and big, in the center of the canvas. Release the mouse (or lift your finger) — the network will shrink your drawing to 8×8 and output probabilities for all ten classes. It's the same softmax as in module 8.
ui.Подсказка: сейчас сеть училась на печатн: Hint: the network has been training on printed fonts, so your handwriting is foreign to it. Go back to step 2, switch the source to handwritten digits — and see how much more confident it gets.
ui.Сеть ошиблась? Ваш почерк она видит впер: Did the network get it wrong? It's seeing your handwriting for the first time. Tell it the right answer — and it will learn from it (a mini version of the fine-tuning from module 7):
ui.Эта страница — просто текстовый файл: ни: This page is just a text file: no server, no "cloud." A couple hundred lines of code and {N} weight numbers found by gradient descent. Large language models are exactly the same — only with billions of times more weights, and instead of digits they predict the next token.
